<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. -->

## Motivation

This PR enhances the SGLang Cookbook by adding the Ascend NPU (**Atlas 800I A3**) deployment scenario for **Qwen3.8-Max** (`Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B`).

- Adds the 4-node Atlas 800I A3 PD co-located deployment recipe.
- Provides interactive command generation with required NPU environment variables, HCCL interconnect flags, and DeepEP/modelslim parameters.
- Updates the installation documentation with official Ascend Docker image guides.

Fixes / Relates to: https://github.com/Ascend/sglang/issues/1220
CC: @amote-i @Estrella-xx

**Draft: On-hardware validation is pending. This PR currently verifies local cookbook configs, selector behavior, and frontend rendering.**

## Modifications

1. `docs/src/snippets/configs/Qwen/qwen3.8.jsx`:
   - Added `"a3"` to `supportedHardware`.
   - Added `Modelslim (W4A8)` to `quantizations`.
   - Added Ascend official Docker image (`quay.io/ascend/sglang:main-cann9.0.0-a3`) to `dockerImages`.
   - Added multi-node HCCL/GLOO network interface binding hints to `multiNodeHints.a3`.
   - Added the 4-node unified PD co-located recipe under `cells[]` with best-practice configurations (W4A8 quantization via modelslim, TP64 + DP4 attention, DeepEP auto mode, overlap stream).

2. `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8.mdx`:
   - Added `<Tab title="NPU">` under the installation section with Docker pull commands and hardware prerequisites.
   - Added notes on Ascend NPU 4-node topology and referenced the detailed deployment tutorial.

## Verification Results

### 1. Cookbook Config Static Check
Ran `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` locally:
```text
cookbook config check: OK
```

### 2. Local Mintlify Documentation Preview
Verified interactive widget and command generation with `mint dev` at `http://localhost:3000/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8`:
- Selecting **Atlas 800I A3** cleanly gates options to **Modelslim (W4A8)**, **Balanced**, and **4 Nodes**.
- Command box emits verified HCCL/GLOO environment flags and `sglang serve` parameters (`--tp-size 64`, `--dp-size 4`, `--moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto`).





## Hardware Blocker & Requested Guidance

I attempted to create the verification environment in HiDevLab. The trial environment only provides single-card (1 NPU) resources by default, whereas Qwen3.8-Max requires a 4-node cluster (32 cards / 64 dies, TP64).

Could the task maintainers help coordinate multi-node cluster permissions for my HiDevLab account, or arrange for someone with suitable hardware to run the verification commands? Once the cluster run is executed, I will update this PR with the startup logs and inference output.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Verify local cookbook configs with `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`.
- [x] Verify local browser rendering with Mintlify preview.
- [ ] Verified deployment and inference on 4*A3 hardware (pending cluster quota).

For detailed deployment instructions on Atlas 800I A3, see the [Qwen3.8-Max Ascend NPU deployment tutorial](../../../docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/tutorials/qwen3_8_max).

@@ -62,6 +76,8 @@ Pick your hardware + quantization to generate the launch command. Three of the s
 - **High Throughput** — most tokens per second across many users. Best for batch jobs.
 - **DSpark** — the trained [DSpark draft model](#3-3-dspark-and-replayssm-speculative-decoding) instead of the checkpoint's built-in MTP head. Only offered where DSpark's constraints allow it (see [3.3](#3-3-dspark-and-replayssm-speculative-decoding)).
 
+Atlas 800I A3 deployment runs across 4 nodes (32 cards / 64 dies) in PD mixed mode with W4A8 quantization. For the step-by-step multi-node tutorial, see [Qwen3.8-Max on Ascend NPU](../../../docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/tutorials/qwen3_8_max).
+
 import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx";
 import { config }     from "/src/snippets/configs/Qwen/qwen3.8.jsx";
 import { benchmarks } from "/src/snippets/configs/Qwen/qwen3.8-benchmarks.jsx";
@@ -204,6 +220,17 @@ Recommended: **MI355X + MXFP4, single node, TP8**. MI350X emits the identical co
 - **`--disable-custom-all-reduce` belongs on every MI300X rank** — SGLang resolves it per process, so setting it on one node would leave the two pipeline stages reducing through different code paths.
 - MI300X runs `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` with `--page-size 16`: at 8 × 192GB per node the shape is memory-bound.
 
+### Ascend NPU (Atlas 800I A3)
+
+The Atlas 800I A3 recipe deploys the W4A8 quantized checkpoint across **4 nodes (32 cards / 64 dies)** in unified PD mixed mode:
+
+- **Tensor Parallelism & Data Parallelism**: Runs `--tp-size 64` across all 64 dies (16 dies per node), combined with DP attention (`--enable-dp-attention --dp-size 4 --enable-dp-lm-head`) for balanced prefill and decode throughput.
+- **MoE Communication**: Uses DeepEP in auto mode (`--moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto`) with INT8 dispatch quantization (`DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1`) for high-bandwidth NPU-to-NPU all-to-all communication.
+- **Overlap Scheduling**: Enables plan stream overlap (`SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1`) and static ragged verify mode (`SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static`) for reduced execution jitter.
+- **Multi-Node Networking**: Multi-node NPU collectives use HCCL and Gloo. Pin the network interface on each node with `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` and `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`.
+
+For the full step-by-step tutorial, see [Qwen3.8-Max on Ascend NPU](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/tutorials/qwen3_8_max).
+
 ### ReplaySSM
 
 A GDN layer's recurrent state overwrites itself every token, so speculative verify has to be rewindable. Snapshotting the whole K×V state per draft step costs 64 KiB per request, layer and head at K=V=128, times γ+1 steps — scratch taken out of the same budget as the persistent state pool.
